description: Used for vehicle accessories which add a visible component to a vehicle. Defines the paths to the visible models and their configuration (variant, look, excluded views), and the collision mesh path if applicable.

name.description: Full name of the accessory for UI display.

short_name.description: Condensed name of the accessory for UI display in contexts with limited space.

icon.description: Path relative to /material/ui/accessory/ to the icon for the accessory, omitting the file extension.

info.description: Additional information about the accessory. Few accessory types still use this for UI display (e.g. engine).

price.description: The price of the accessory in the store in the base currency (ETS2 -> EUR, ATS -> USD). If zero, the accessory will not be visible to the player.

unlock.description: The minimum level the player must achieve before the accessory becomes available in the store.
unlock.notes: Default value: 0. The wiki only says "uint" without specifying a bit width — u32 is the common convention for this kind of value elsewhere in the docs, but this isn't explicitly confirmed for this specific attribute.

part_type.description: Defines the icon and tooltip shown on the accessory.

suitable_for.description: Each member specifies a unit name (or a wildcard pattern using *) which must be present on the vehicle for this accessory to become visible in the store and applicable to the vehicle.

conflict_with.description: Each member specifies a unit name (or a wildcard pattern using *) this accessory is incompatible with. Conflicting accessories are removed from the vehicle when this one is applied.

defaults.description: Each member specifies a path to an accessory definition file applied to the vehicle if no other suitable accessory of the same type exists on it.

overrides.description: Each member specifies a path to an accessory definition file applied to the vehicle, overriding other accessories of the same type if one already exists. Avoids the need for suitable_for/defaults in most cases (e.g. engine badges and sounds).

require.description: Each member specifies an accessory type (the final segment of a unit name) that must also exist on the vehicle while this accessory is installed. Every required type should always have a corresponding entry in defaults.

exterior_model.description: Path to the model descriptor (.pmd) displayed in the exterior view, if applicable.
exterior_model.notes: The wiki lists this attribute's type as plain "string", not "resource_tie", even though it's a model path — kept as documented rather than reinterpreted.

exterior_model_uk.description: Path to the model descriptor (.pmd) displayed in the exterior view for right-hand drive vehicles. Defaults to exterior_model when unset.

interior_model.description: Path to the model descriptor (.pmd) displayed in the interior view, if applicable.

interior_model_uk.description: Path to the model descriptor (.pmd) displayed in the interior view for right-hand drive vehicles. Defaults to interior_model when unset.

coll.description: Path to the collision descriptor (.pmc) for the accessory, if applicable.

look.description: Name of the look used on all descriptors of this accessory. All models for an accessory must have the same set of looks.

variant.description: Name of the variant used on all descriptors of this accessory. All models for an accessory must have the same set of variants.

hide_in.description: Flag for hiding the accessory from being drawn in specific views. Accessories whose model references mirror-reflection textures (e.g. the mirror itself) MUST be marked as not visible in mirrors.
